color-surface-primary.$description: Panels and cards. The page is song-workshop-page, with a lesson's tint on top.

color-surface-secondary.$description: Hover and selected fills in design system components.

color-surface-tertiary.$description: Switch tracks, filled progression slots, W/H step labels.

color-text-secondary.$description: Hints and labels. Passes only just on the tints and soft fills: don't make it lighter.

color-border-default.$description: Panel edges, dividers, chord-card and key-pill borders. Not 3:1, and doesn't need to be (port spec Q9).

color-border-strong.$description: Design system form fields: at least 3:1 on panels, page and both tints.

color-border-focus.$description: The accent fill. A lesson in minor points it at song-workshop-minor (architecture.md §4).

color-accent-default.$description: Major. Light is a touch darker than the file's #178A63, for 4.5:1 with white (port spec C-03).

color-accent-hover.$description: 12% towards black in light, towards white in dark.

color-accent-pressed.$description: 24% towards black in light, towards white in dark.

color-accent-foreground.$description: The same in major and minor.

color-accent-text.$description: Major as text. Darker than the fill in light, for 4.5:1 on the tint and soft fill (port spec C-05).

font-family-heading.$description: Headings, numbers and note names. Self-hosted from Fontsource with the optical-size axis (decisions/0005).

font-family-base.$description: Body text and controls. Self-hosted from Fontsource at 400, 500 and 600.

font-weight-display.$description: Page title, key name, chord and slot numbers (port spec C-08).

song-workshop-page.$description: The untinted page, painted on html and body. A lesson paints its tint on top.

song-workshop-minor.$description: Accent fill in minor, and the focus ring in minor.

song-workshop-tint-major.$description: The page in major: 5% accent in the page colour.

song-workshop-soft-major.$description: Soft fill behind chosen things in major: 13% accent in the panel colour.

song-workshop-font-weight-strong.$description: Uppercase labels, secondary names, step titles, key pills, path buttons, tempo value, scale degrees, W/H labels. Not font-weight-label, which means form-field labels.

song-workshop-easing-settle.$description: Starts quickly, lands softly. Every lesson transition and animation.

song-workshop-duration-state.$description: Colour, border and fill changes on hover and selection.

song-workshop-duration-move.$description: Movement: chord lift, panel highlight, slot pop-in, play button lift.

song-workshop-duration-slide.$description: The sliding thumb and key indicator.

song-workshop-duration-tonality.$description: Accent colour changing between major and minor.

song-workshop-duration-page.$description: Page tint changing between major and minor.
